_meta.purpose: Comp comparison baseline for the drawer's side-by-side comp table (4.03). Edit data/xge-baseline.json (gitignored) to override these defaults with your actual current-role numbers. The fields below are public-info approximations of a Google PgM L6/L7 in the xGE org, used as defaults when xge-baseline.json is absent. Update annually or whenever your comp/benefits change.

comp_base: ~$130K base (Google L6/L7 PgM range — approximate; edit data/xge-baseline.json to set actual)
equity_rsus: Google RSUs on 4-yr vest (25% Y1/Y2/Y3/Y4); GOOGL liquid on vest, no dilution risk
benefits: Best-in-class: HMO/PPO health, dental, vision, life, $4K/yr fitness reimbursement, on-site meals + amenities, free transit, Google Wallet perks
vacation_sick: 20 days vacation + 80 hrs sick/yr (accrues + rolls over); plus 10 paid holidays + 18 wks paid parental leave
stock_price_valuation: GOOGL ~$179 (public, fully liquid, vesting at trade price)
annual_bonuses: Annual perf bonus (5–15% of base typical for PgM L6); spot bonuses + Google peer bonuses ($100–$500)
k401_match: Google matches 50% of contributions up to IRS limit ($23,500 in 2026)
hybrid_policy: 3 days/wk in-office (Mountain View HQ); 2 days WFH flex; team-dependent
